# Troubleshooting — samplekata

> Known pitfalls and their resolutions. The goal is that any
> contributor — human or LLM — can search this file before re-deriving
> a fix from scratch. Append entries as you encounter and resolve real
> problems; do not invent hypothetical ones.

---

## Format

Each entry uses the following structure:

### _A short symptom phrase_

**Symptom**

> What the error looks like (copy a real message when possible).

**Cause**

> The actual underlying reason, not a workaround description.

**Fix**

> Exact steps. Prefer commands over prose.

**Updated**: YYYY-MM-DD

---

## Entries

_No entries yet. Add the first one when you debug something
non-obvious. Common Flutter starters: pub get failures, iOS Pod
mismatch, Gradle JDK mismatch, golden test platform drift._
